periods.time: After Stella returns to Vermillion, before the Quedland visit
periods.location: Vermillion castle training courtyard and Freyaveg streets
periods.summary: Jealous of Ikki taking Stella's affection, King Sirius challenges him to simulated combat, arm wrestling, and a marathon errand to Bonny House for chocolate taiyaki. Ikki wins every test: he instantly exploits Sirius' left-eye blind spot, overpowers him through total body control, and completes the run while Sirius gets lost trying a shortcut. Despite the farce, Ikki sincerely accepts every test because he understands Sirius' attachment to Stella.
periods.cause: Sirius wants to recover his fatherly dignity and prove Ikki unworthy before accepting him as Stella's partner and Vermillion representative.
periods.process: Sirius declares a one-on-one Fantasy Form duel and loses in five seconds when Ikki reads his impaired left eye. He then changes the rules to arm wrestling and loses because Ikki can consciously release his full physical strength. Sirius invents a third, high-value marathon test, attempts to cheat by using a local shortcut, and gets lost while Ikki returns first with the taiyaki. Afterward the maids flock to Ikki, Stella chases them, and Lunaeyes brings Timid and Milialia to request Ikki's training help.
periods.outcome: Ikki earns more respect from Astrea and Stella's circle, while Sirius still refuses to openly concede. The family dynamic around Ikki is established as affectionate but difficult.
periods.significance: Shows Ikki's sincerity toward Stella's family, exposes Sirius' left-eye injury and deep paternal love, and sets up Ikki training Vermillion's representatives.
